title: Launching and scaling AI systems
caption: Six stages from the first decision to accountable operation: the question each stage must answer, and the sources worth reading there. Read across for the route, down for the evidence.
loop: What production teaches goes back to Frame.

frame.label: Move on when
frame.text: there is a named owner, a decision this will change, and a measure of success agreed before building.

pilot.label: Move on when
pilot.text: results on real data beat a simple baseline, and the failures are written down, not only the average.

launch.label: Move on when
launch.text: a staged rollout, a tested rollback and a human escalation path are live before the first user.

scale.label: Move on when
scale.text: the cost of a completed task is known, and the platform enforces limits on spend and agent loops.

operate.label: In control when
operate.text: every request leaves one connected trace, incidents are reviewed, and each lesson becomes an evaluation.

govern.label: In control when
govern.text: every system has an accountable owner and a record of what it did, on whose authority and why.
